documents.title: Steel wire ropes for general engineering purposes
documents.raw_text:
This standard covers steels wire ropes for general engineering purposes such as hoisting, hauling and towing. It specifies the materials, construction, breaking loads and marking requirements.

The standards listed in this clause are necessary adjuncts to this standard. IS 1835 specifies the method for tensile testing of steel wire.

For the purpose of this standard, the following definitions apply. Core: the inner part of a fibre or steel core. Lay: the helical disposition of wires in a strand.

Steel shall be of a quality adapted to the class of rope. Wire shall be bright or galvanised as specified, free from harmful defects.

The number and arrangement of strands and wires shall be as given in the tables. Each strand shall be formed of wires laid helically around the core.

The minimum breaking load of a rope shall be computed from the sum of the breaking loads of individual wires multiplied by a spinning factor.

Every rope shall be marked with the IS number, manufacturer's name or trade mark, and the class of rope.

documents.title: Portable fire extinguishers, water type
documents.raw_text:
This standard specifies the requirements and methods of test for portable fire extinguishers of the water type for fighting Class A fires.

Charge: the content of the extinguisher. Discharge time: the time taken for the discharge of the full charge under specified conditions.

The shell shall be of mild steel sheet, seamless drawn or welded, having a minimum thickness as given in Table 1.

The extinguisher shall be subjected to a proof pressure test, a freezing test and a discharge test.

Each extinguisher shall carry the IS number, the nominal water capacity in litres, and the operating instructions.

documents.title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2025
documents.raw_text:
The Order may be called the Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2025. It shall come into force on the 15th day of February, 2026.

In this Order, 'standard' means the relevant Indian Standard. 'Schedule' means a Schedule annexed to this Order.

No person shall manufacture or store specified steel products for the purpose of sale unless they conform to the relevant Indian Standard and bear the Standard Mark.

The Bureau of Indian Standards may, for the purpose of ensuring conformity, take samples and cause them to be tested.

Any person who contravenes the provisions of this Order shall be punishable in accordance with Section BR of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.

documents.title: Quality Control Order for Domestic Water Heaters, 2025
documents.raw_text:
This Order may be called the Quality Control Order for Domestic Water Heaters, 2025, and shall come into force on the date specified in the notification.

The provisions of this Order shall apply to electric immersion water heaters covered under IS 5509.

Domestic water heaters shall bear the Standard Mark under a licence from the Bureau of Indian Standards, conforming to IS 5509:2023.

The manufacturer shall be responsible for conformity of the product with the applicable standard at all times.
